result.title: Same Story, Different Lens: A Multi-Agent System for Cross-Outlet News Framing Analysis
result.comment: The projects source code is available in the GitHub repository. Link: https://github.com/affanyasin1/multi-perspective-analyzer
result.summary: News outlets covering the same event differ in what they emphasize and omit. \textit{Same Story, Different Lens} is an experimental research prototype for comparing these choices. It collects world and politics coverage from 17 outlets, groups reports about the same event, and produces structured analyses of sentiment, political lean, framing, loaded language, possible omissions, and model-estimated proportions of factual claims and opinion. Loaded-language entries include quotations and neutral rewordings. Three model roles (agents) handle article analysis, assessment of source support, and cross-outlet briefing generation. Analyses are stored in a JSONL archive. The evaluation compares outlet-level lean estimates with approximate, predefined reference ratings and summarizes the Critic's model-assigned grounding scores. These measures provide preliminary diagnostics. A grounding score reflects the model's assessment of support in the supplied text and does not establish factual accuracy or constitute independent verification.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建一个三智能体原型系统：抓取17家媒体的世界与政治报道并按同一事件分组，生成情感、政治倾向、框架、倾向性用语与可能遗漏等结构化分析，再用预设参考评级和模型自评的 grounding 分数做初步诊断。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「文章分析—来源支持核查—跨源简报」的 agent 分工与基于给定文本的 grounding 评分，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与答案归因核查提供文本域参照；但全文不涉及 latent 状态或多模态推理，该自评分数能否作为独立监督信号需核查。
